status_note: Proposed on 24 October 2026; the brief for its first session is written. Waits for the editor's go, the first session's key handshake and abp's policy change.
objective: Take the evidence the curator promoted since the last export through to the site, by fixed rules, in one release a wake: export, claim verdicts, the compromise and offline rows, the 'as of' lines.
session: a new persistent session for the scheduled journalist, woken by a scheduled task the editor creates
instructions: Scheduled journalist wake. You are journalist@php.newsroom (Sonnet) for php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai. Follow "Every wake" in admin/content/briefs/2026-10-24__brief__the-journalist.md, steps 1 to 7, and its "When the release stops" and "Never" sections, word for word. If the evidence vault's head equals data/vault.json head.commit, say "nothing new: evidence vault at <head>" in one line and do not commit. If a new source names an organisation compromised through php2shell, do not edit no-confirmed-compromise: release the export, send a To-correspondent note, and stop. If your pki key pair or your evidence-vault clone is gone, say "needs a new key handshake" and stop. Never print a key or token.

pull the evidence vault read-only; no new head: one line, no commit
